tools.name: search_agencies
tools.description: Find, list or compare maid / domestic-worker recruitment agencies (housemaids, nannies, cooks, drivers, caregivers) in a city or country - e.g. 'maid agencies in Dubai' -> city: Dubai. Use this for any 'agencies in <place>' question. Searches agencies listed on GCC Domestic across the six GCC countr

tools.name: verify_agency_licence
tools.description: Check the licence of ONE specific agency the user names (or its licence / facility number). Not for finding or listing agencies in a city or country - use search_agencies for that. Look up by agency name, or by licence / facility number (e.g. a UAE MOHRE facility number or Saudi Musaned reference).

tools.name: search_workers
tools.description: Browse domestic workers currently listed as available through GCC agencies listed on GCC Domestic - housemaids, nannies, cooks, drivers and caregivers. Filter by nationality and/or position. Returns public profile info and the agency to contact; hiring goes through the worker's agency.

tools.name: get_salary_benchmarks
tools.description: Published monthly salary benchmarks for domestic workers in the Gulf, by country and worker nationality. These are the same bands published across gccdomestic.com (salary calculator, 2026 salary report). Currencies: UAE in AED, Saudi Arabia in SAR.

tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: Semantic search over GCC Domestic's published guides, blog posts and country pages (English + Arabic): visas, Tadbeer/Musaned/PAM/ADLSA/LMRA/MOL procedures, salaries, contracts, refunds, worker rights. Returns title, URL and a snippet. Read-only; each result carries its URL.

tools.name: get_platform_guide
tools.description: How hiring a domestic worker through GCC Domestic works, with canonical links: country directories, the application page for workers, pricing, and verification guides. Use this to orient before deeper searches, or to hand a user the right link.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_agencies" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search domestic-worker recruitment agencies listed on GCC Domestic across the six GCC countries (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman). Filter by country, city and/or a free-text name query. Returns contact details, whether each agency is government-verified (1,300+ are), and the official" → after: "Find, list or compare maid / domestic-worker recruitment agencies (housemaids, nannies, cooks, drivers, caregivers) in a city or country - e.g. 'maid agencies in Dubai' -> city: Dubai. Use this for any 'agencies in <place>' question. Searches agencies listed on GCC Domestic across the six GCC countr"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
